# horizOn App API reference

116 HTTP operations from the [hosted App OpenAPI](https://horizon.pm/v3/api-docs/app).
Read the OpenAPI resource for the relevant section to see parameters, payload schemas, responses and security definitions.
The linked guides describe session requirements, setup, SDK usage and workflows such as WebSocket subscriptions.
For Dashboard operations and key scopes, read <horizon://docs/dashboard>. For current quotas, read <horizon://docs/limits>.

## leaderboards

OpenAPI <horizon://api/openapi/leaderboards> · Guide <horizon://docs/leaderboard>

## user-management

OpenAPI <horizon://api/openapi/user-management> · Guide <horizon://docs/auth>

- `POST /api/v1/app/user-management/change-name` — Change Name - Update logged-in user's display name
- `POST /api/v1/app/user-management/check-auth` — Check Authentication - Verify user authentication status
- `POST /api/v1/app/user-management/forgot-password` — Forgot Password - Request password reset
- `POST /api/v1/app/user-management/refresh-session` — Rotate an app-user session
- `POST /api/v1/app/user-management/reset-password` — Reset Password - Complete password reset with token
- `POST /api/v1/app/user-management/signin` — Sign In - Authenticate existing user
- `POST /api/v1/app/user-management/signout`
- `POST /api/v1/app/user-management/signup` — Sign Up - Create new user account
- `POST /api/v1/app/user-management/verify-email` — Verify Email - Confirm user email address
